statement.p: Match the graphs below with the following descriptions by indicating the graph corresponding to each description in the answer blank to the left of the description. (Note that because this is a matching question, it does not show which parts are incorrect.)

li.p: The cost of a product in an economy suffering from a constant inflation rate that persists over a very long time.
The amount of a drug in a patient's body as a function of time after he takes a pill.
The distance from the finish line of a runner waiting for the start of a race and then running at a constant speed.
The average water level in a bay between successive high tides.
The temperature of a metal ingot placed in a furnace and then removed.

image.description: graph of a function that starts with a positive y-value and decreases with a slowly decreasing rate to slowly approach the x-axis.
graph of a continuous function that is a horizontal line at a positive y-value for the first 2/3 of the graph, then a line with a negative slope that decreases towards the x-axis.

graph of a continuous function that increases from zero or near zero, initially rapidly but with a decreasing rate; after reaching a peak with near zero slope, it decreases, again initially rapidly but then with a decreasing rate.
graph of a function with a relatively small initial value, that increases at a slowly increasing rate.
graph of a function that starts with a positive y-value, decreases and then increases sinusoidally.

solution.p: 1. The answer is E, because the cost of the product, in the absence of any change in inflation, increases exponentially.
2. The answer is A, because the amount of the drug in the patient's body decays exponentially.
3. The answer is D, because the runner is initially a constant distance away from the finish line, and then when running at a constant speed this distance decreases linearly.
4. The answer is C, because the tides are cyclical, and the height must therefore oscillate.
5. The answer is B, because the ingot will get hot and then cool off, so the temperature will increase and then decrease.
